results.title: A claim resting on a missing fact under freshness
results.evidence: a claim resting on a present fact and a MISSING one answers freshness 1000.0, the same as one resting on that fact and a stale one. FRESHNESS is (max, max) with `zero = 0.0`, so an absent fact contributes 0.0 and `max` discards it — the answer is the freshness of what is present, and carries nothing saying a term was absent. The Boolean semiring answers the presence question; a reader who asks onl
